valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: total equity is not on file for Q2 2026, so a P/B cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: revenue is not on file or not positive for Q2 2026. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for Q2 2026, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.

derived.ytdBasis: year to date from the last close before 2026 (2025-12-31, 100.0) to the price on 2026-09-21
